scope: Approved coordination-model inventory for the six explicitly drawn WVB100*7 brace bars in A11/AANZICHT as-1. This is not a fabrication or as-built model.

change_visualisation.meaning: Display-only identification of this development change set. It does not describe steel paint, coating, material, construction status or source confidence.

source_projection.method: Brace centreline endpoints are the midpoint of the paired source-outline endpoints already projected in Section_A11_Axis_1. Gaps at intermediate rails remain a source-graphic interruption of one continuous labelled brace, not separate members.

WVB100*7.representation: Nominal 100x7 rectangular flat-bar solid for coordination. End connections, bolts, gusset plates, tension state, material grade and fabrication details are excluded.

centreline_definitions_mm.method: Each endpoint is the midpoint of the two source-outline extremities for one visibly continuous, explicitly labelled WVB bar in the calibrated A11/as-1 source projection. The stated per-member margin is the largest half separation of the paired outline endpoints; it is source-projection uncertainty, not an as-built survey tolerance.
centreline_definitions_mm.section_orientation: A11/as-1 is a YZ elevation at X=65160 mm. The flat-bar width is in the elevation plane and its 7-mm thickness is out of plane along X.

A11_01_WVB401_ASC.derivation: Midpoint of paired source-outline endpoints from projected PDF paths 254/255.

A11_01_WVB401_DESC.derivation: Midpoint of paired source-outline endpoints from projected PDF path 313. The repeated source mark 401 is retained for this separately drawn physical bar.

A11_01_WVB402.derivation: Midpoint of paired source-outline endpoints from projected PDF path 256.

A11_01_WVB399.derivation: Midpoint of source-outline endpoints from projected PDF paths 257/258, preserving the graphic interruption at intermediate rails as one continuous brace.

A11_01_WVB403.derivation: Midpoint of paired source-outline endpoints from projected PDF path 259.

explicitly_not_inferred: No WVB, K, CN, secondary-steel or brace member outside the six explicitly drawn bars is included.
No unobserved counterpart is mirrored or repeated from the WVB400, WVB401, WVB402, WVB399 or WVB403 patterns.
No brace is placed at any station other than A11/as-1 X=65160 mm.
No connections, bolts, gusset plates, cleats, stiffeners, rail interruptions or member overlap at crossings is modelled.
The source drawing and projection prove nominal configuration, not an as-built survey or fabrication definition.
